description: This file defines the QueryFilter class used for filtering display entities such as categories or search results based on related entities like Manufacturer. It includes fields for filter code, ID, and type, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: QueryFilter
classes.description: Represents a filter used in category and search functionalities to filter display based on associated entities like Manufacturer

methods.name: getFilterCode
methods.description: Returns the filter code used for filtering on an entity code

methods.name: setFilterCode
methods.description: Sets the filter code used for filtering on an entity code

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the type of the filter

methods.name: setFilterType
methods.description: Sets the type of the filter
